configurePresets.name: msvc-ninja
configurePresets.description: Configure for ${displayName}. Needs cl.exe on PATH - a developer command prompt, or a shell vcvars has been applied to - because with Ninja CMake finds the compiler there rather than through the generator. Unqualified 'msvc' stays the Visual Studio generator, which is what a client working in the IDE wants; Ninja is for everything else, CI included, and it separates cl.exe's cost from msbuild's.
